```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roualdes/data/master/email.csv"
suppressMessages(email <- read.csv(url))
head(email)
```

```{r}
xbar <- mean(email$num_char)
s <- sd(email$num_char)
n <- length(email$num_char)
alpha <- 0.05
se <- s / sqrt(n)
t.star <- qt(1 - alpha, n - 1)
ME <- se * t.star
c(-Inf, xbar + ME)
```

## Lightbulb

```{r}
mu <- 12000
n <- 64
xbar <- 11297
s <- 2418
alpha <- (1 - 0.87)
se <- s / sqrt(n)
tstar <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, n - 1)
me <- se * tstar
c(xbar - me, xbar + me)
```
